response.sql: WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CASE WHEN w IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL AND g > 0 THEN CAST(w AS FLOAT) / CAST(g AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), mean_avg_win_rate AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) as overall_mean FROM team_stats WHERE avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT ts.team_id, ts.avg_win_rate, ts.record_count, ts.avg_win_rate - mar.overall_mean as diff_from_mean FROM team_stats ts CROSS JOIN mean_avg_win_rate mar WHERE mar.overall_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN ts.avg_win_rate - mar.overall_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ts.avg_win_rate - mar.overall_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: record_count includes all manager_half records for the team, not just those with valid (non-NULL, non-zero g) win/game values used in the average
Records where g=0 are excluded from the average win rate (division by zero is undefined)

alternatives.interpretation: record_count should count only the records actually used in the average win rate calculation (those with non-NULL w, g and g > 0)
